# Software and lessons made by others

Shipped with MeshLearn, unchanged except where noted. Each folder holds its licence.

| What | Version | Licence | From |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| KaTeX (equations) | 0.16.11 | MIT; only the WOFF2 fonts are kept | https://katex.org |
| Signature Pad (scratchpad) | 4.1.7 | MIT, Szymon Nowak | https://github.com/szimek/signature_pad |
| OpenDyslexic (letters) | Fontsource 5.2.5, Latin | SIL Open Font License 1.1, Abbie Gonzalez | https://opendyslexic.org |
| Papa Parse (spreadsheet import) | 5.4.1 | MIT, Matthew Holt | https://www.papaparse.com |
| qrcode-generator (QR codes) | 1.4.4 | MIT, Copyright (c) 2009 Kazuhiko Arase (notice in the file) | https://github.com/kazuhikoarase/qrcode-generator |

The npm packages were checked against the sha512 published on the npm registry.

Copied to memory cards only when a teacher chooses them, and credited beside each one on the phone:

- **PhET**: "Simulation by PhET Interactive Simulations, University of Colorado Boulder, licensed under CC BY 4.0
  (https://phet.colorado.edu)." Kolibri's copies were published in 2024; PhET versions from 29 March 2026 on have other terms.
- **Blockly Games**: Google; listed by Kolibri as public domain.
- **GeoGebra** (c) GeoGebra GmbH, https://www.geogebra.org. Free to copy and distribute for non-commercial use only, with this credit,
